femaleIdols.description: 1000°, also written as Cheondo and formerly known by her name Seobin, is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Sticky House Entertainment. She made her debut as a soloist on May 28, 2022, with her first digital single, "Schaden Flower". She is also known for being a former contestant on Mnet's music survival show CAP-TEEN.

1014, formerly known as Jeong Yeonsoo, is a South Korean singer and songwriter under INHEART MUSIC. Prior to her official debut, she released several singles under her birth name Jeong Yeonsoo. On 5th of October 2018 she was revealed to be under INHEART MUSIC on their offical instagram. She made her official debut on November 19, 2020, with the digital single album "Don't Disappear" (featuring Yoo Jisoo of Chamsom).
148 is a South Korean singer, born on Feburary 14, and member of the South Korean live idol girl group Reconquista. She used to be in the group YUBiKiRi, but graduated soon after on April 27, 2024.

19 (NANA) is a South Korean indie singer and songwriter who debuted in 2018 with her single album Summer Side A. Known for her emotional and expressive music, she blends indie and alternative pop styles in her songs. Her debut track, Jelly, drew attention for its unique sound and heartfelt lyrics. Nana has also released an EP titled Pretty Error, showcasing her versatility as an artist. Since her debut, she has been actively pursuing her music career, sharing her work on platforms like Spotify, YouTube, and SoundCloud. Her music often explores deep and personal themes, connecting with listeners through honest and evocative storytelling.

Won So Yoon, better known as 1soyun, is an independent R&B and Soul solo singer and dancer. She made her debut with the self written and composed “Sweet Time” on August 4, 2020. She is a member of dance team Aight9 under the stage name Yunny.
Bae Hye-jin, also known as 200 is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Luminant Entertainment in 2024.
21univ. is a South Korean singer under Xanadu Entertainment who debuted on April 12, 2021 with the single album “Love Naturally”.
2Da_Yellow is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2023.
599 is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the Vocalist and Drummer of the South Korean girl rock band fishingirls under Naturally Music. She joined the group in 2016 and left in 2019.

5Joo is a South Korean singer and streamer, she is a former member and the Main Vocalist of the girl group ikling under CodeM Entertainment. She debuted as a soloist with the mini album "Let’s Go To See The Flowers" on August 14, 2019. She debuted in the project girl group, ikling on April 28, 2023 with the release of their first digital single, "Stargram". She then left the group before their line up change.
99honest is a South Korean singer-songwriter. She made her debut on September 15, 2021, with the digital single "Blue Day".

A Ryeom is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Vanilla Music. She is a member of co-ed duo Seasoning and is a former member of the girl group SHA SHA under Major Entertainment. She made her debut in the girl group SHA SHA on February 27, 2018, with the single album "You & Me Forever SHASHA."

A Young is a South Korean singer and model. She was a member of the South Korean girl group ATT under Broad Entertainment. She debuted with the South Korean girl group ATT on October 7th, 2015 with their song ”Temptation” but the group disbanded in 2016.

A Zi is a South Korean model and singer. She is a former member and the Main Vocalist and Sub Rapper of the girl group PPL under Parksal Company. She made her debut with the girl group PPL on October 30, 2015, with their single "Rush". The group disbanded in 2018.

A-hyeon is a South Korean singer under EMMP Company. She is a member of the girl group I:mond. She debuted with the girl group I:mond on June 4, 2024, with the single album "We Are Gravity" with the title track "Slippery".
A-na is a South Korean singer and MC under SM Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Hearts2Hearts.
A-ra is a South Korean singer under Liz Entertainment and a former member of the girl group Girl's World.

A-Yeon is a South Korean musician and singer under HMI Entertainment. She is a former member and Drummer and Vocalist of the female pop-rock band Bebop under HMI Entertainment. She made her debut with the female pop-rock band on February 14, 2014, with the mini-album "Between Calm and Passion." Due to inactivity since 2016, it is presumed that the group has disbanded. She made her solo debut on July 28, 2018 with the single "Midsummer Night".

A-Zzang is a South Korean singer, drummer, and member of the girl band Walking After U under LODIS Company. She’s a former member and Drummer of South Korean indie rock band Swingz. In June 2013 Swingz collaborated on stage with another all-female indie rock band Rubber Duckie and formed the project group Walking After U. She debuted with Walking After U on September 19, 2014.
A.Jia is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group LIVE HIGH. In 2013, A.Jia left the group after the change of the CEO and company.

A'mei is a Japanese singer under NTT Docomo Studio & Live and Sony Music Entertainment Korea. She is a member of the global girl group cosmosy, with whom she debuted on December 31, 2024 in Japan and February 7, 2025 globally with the digital single "zigy=zingy", and later officially on April 11, 2025 with the digital single "Lucky=One".

Aalia, formerly known by her real name Park Yeseo, is an independent South Korean singer-songwriter. She debuted on December 26, 2018 with the release of her first digital single, "Maybe I Was Wrong".
Abi is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group EVAS.
Abigail is a Peruvian singer signed under World K-Pop Center. She is part of the multinational girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE-PE.

Abin formerly known as Sha Sha is a South Korean singer under Liz Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group ICU, the project girl group Chic&I's and the girl group M.prism. She is also a former member of the girl groups Chic Angel and YJIG. She made her solo debut on February 29, 2024 with the "The Last Cold Snap".
Able, formerly known as Jelly,is a South Korean singer under Donuts Culture. She is a member of the duo A+B and a former member of the group Maywish.

Acare, also known as Narin is a Thai dancer and singer. She is best known for being a contestant on "U2U: Up To You Season 2" in which she ranked first and became a temporary member of the girl group Up To You. She made her debut with the group on August 4, 2023 with the digital single "Crush On You".
Acy blu is a South Korean singer under Irrelevant Music. She officially debuted on May 2, 2021, with the single “Nonlove”.

ADÉLA is a Slovak singer-songwriter and dancer. She is mostly known for her participation in HYBE x Geffen Records' survival show “The Debut: Dream Academy“, from which she was eliminated. ADÉLA made her solo debut on September 13, 2024, with the release of the digital single "HOMEWRECKED".

Adoo, formerly known as Soli, is a South Korean singer. She made her debut as a member of the girl group Baby Boo in 2015 with the song "Boo Boo Boo". In 2016, after months of absence, Hyunda Company confirmed Soli, alongside Chaei, had left Baby Boo. On May 15, 2024, she debuted as a solo artist under the stage name Adoo, releasing the digital single "Hello Goodbye."

Park Soo Hyun, known professionally as Adora (stylized as ADORA), is a South Korean singer and songwriter signed with AURA Entertainment. She initially gained recognition as a producer under Big Hit Music and was previously a trainee with Music K Entertainment. Adora was originally set to debut with the girl group The Ark but did not debut for unspecified reasons. She made her solo debut on November 5, 2021.
Ae Jin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Melody Pink, but left the group in early 2018.
Aejeong is a South Korean singer, and a member of the live idol girl group REKIREM. She was also a contestant on Girls Frontier.
Aeji is a South Korean singer and dancer. She is the former maknae of the girl group Hashtag.

Agenda, born Lim Su-yeon is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Talented and Gesserit the 5th february 2022 with her single All that jazz. She did a comeback the 12th june 2022 with another single, AGENDA.
Ago (stylized as AgØ) is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2019.
AGsungeun is a solo R&B singer and also a vocal trainer under WIP Company.
Ah Hee is a South Korean model and former singer. She is a former member of the girl group PPL.
Ah Young (also stylized as Ayoung) is a South Korean singer and actress under iAA Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Dalshabet.
Ahee was a South Korean trainee. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group, IOLITE, which was set to debut in August 2022. For undisclosed reasons, the group was dissolved before debut.

Lee Ah In is a South Korean singer. She is the Main Vocalist of the girl roup MOMOLAND. She earned fourth place in the reality survival show "Finding Momoland", earning her a spot in the group. She debuted as a member of MOMOLAND on November 10, 2016 with their first mini album Welcome to Momoland. On February 14, 2023, MOMOLAND announced their offical disbandment, however on April 10, 2025, MOMOLAND announced their return, now under Inyeon Entertainment (the same agency as 1THE9's former member Lee "ONLEE" Seung-hwan)
Ahn Da Bi is a South Korean singer under Maroo Entertainment. She was a contestant on MIXNINE. She is currently an actress under Crebig Entertainment.

Ahn Daeun was a South Korean singer under ADE MUSIC. She made her official solo debut on November 20, 2020 with the single album Ego. She’s currently a member of the duo The Ade, which consists of her and Woody Kim (Kim Gyunyeon), a former fellow Acoustic Collabo member. She was a member of Acoustic Collabo. They debuted in 2010, but she left in 2016.
Ahn Miji is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group FIONA.
Ahn Nai Young is a South Korean former singer. She was a member of the girl group Swi.T.

Ahn Seungbi is a South Korean singer and dancer under Daekyo Media Contents Business Division. She is a member of the co-ed kids group Play With Me Club and a former pre-debut member of the project kids girl group Hi Dream. She is best known for participating in the survival show Universe Ticket.
Ahn So Jin was a South Korean trainee under DSP Media. She was contestant on the reality shows Superstar K1 and KARA Project. On February 24, 2015, she passed away by apparent suicide.
Ahn Yeeun is a South Korean singer and songwriter under XX Entertainment who debuted on December 16, 2016 with her self-titled album. She was a contestant of Kpop Star 5, where she was the runner-up.

Ahn Yeseul is a South Korean independent singer. She ranked #32 on Episode 10 of Produce 101 Season 1 and was eliminated. In 2012, Yeseul was a finalist on Super Star K 4. Yeseul represented MAJESTY Entertainment during Produce 101, she left the agency after the show. Since Produce 101, Yeseul has been steadily recording various OSTs and posting on her YouTube channel.
Ahn Yujin is a South Korean singer. She was a part of the co-ed group Space A.

Ahn Yumi is a South Korean professional pilates instructor, singer and actress. Yumi ranked #63 in Episode 5 of Produce 101 Season 1 and was eliminated. She was a member of Twinkle but left the group after the other members left Blessing Entertainment.
Ahon is a South Korean singer under Forbest Entertainment and Midas Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group CrazAngel and a former predebut member of the disbanded girl group IRION Girls.
Ahra is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group K-Girls. She was a vocalist and visual in K-Girls.
Go Ah Ra was the Main Vocalist, Center and Maknae of the girl group FAVORITE. She is a former “K-Pop Star 6” contestant and participated in MIXNINE. She made her debut with FAVORITE in July 6, 2017.
Ahra is a South Korean trainee. She is a former predebut member of upcoming girl group iii.
Ahri is a South Korean singer under SRP Entertainmentand a member of the girl group Rocking Doll.

Ahri is the leader, founder, and main vocalist of the virtual girl group K/DA. She has a confident charm that captivates the audience on stage. She is the calm center of the group, who values authentic self-expression and inspires her team to do the same. She enjoys finding new talents and helping them reach their full potential.

Ahryung is a South Korean trainee, model, choreographer, dancer, and actress signed with GKMNEO. She used to be part of the pre-debut kpop girl group MuuTive. She was also set to participate in the survival show rookie_find which was also later cancelled.

Jung Ahyeon is a South Korean singer, rapper, and dancer under YG Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl group BABYMONSTER. On November 15, 2023, it was announced that she temporarily left the team due to health reasons and BABYMONSTER will debut as a six-member group. However, it was later confirmed by YG that Ahyeon will remain a member of the group but will not participate in debut activities due to health issues. On January 25, 2024, YG Entertainment announced that Ahyeon would be rejoining BABYMONSTER due to improvements in her health and she would be participating in the group's then upcoming mini album in April. Ahyeon later debuted on April 1st, 2024, with the mini album "BABYMONS7ER" from which the already-released singles "Batter Up" and "Stuck In The Middle" were re-recorded to include Ahyeon. On January 15, 2023, Ahyeon was revealed as the second member of BABYMONSTER. The group officially debuted on March 31, 2024, with their mini album "BABYMONS7ER".
Ahyoon is a South Korean singer under XX Entertainment but quietly ended the contract. She is the maknae of the girl group BOTOPASS.
Ahyoon is a South Korean singer under Big Mountain Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Queenz Eye.
Ahyung is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group P.O.P. She does taekwondo, gymnastics, squash, yoga and she is good at rope jumping.

Ahyul was a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the girl group LPG. She was a 3rd-generation member. She joined the group in 2013 and left in 2015. She is now a sports announcer and an actress.
AI is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group MaskOT.
Aiai is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Talented on August 4, 2021 with "Love N Headache". She joined Giriboy's company howtouse in 2024.
Aiala is a Chinese trainee, primarily known for her participation in the reality show Time Turner.

Amy Lee, known professionally as Ailee, is a Korean-American singer & songwriter under A2Z Entertainment. Ailee is considered as one of the most talented vocalists in Korea, even being referred to as ‘the Beyoncé of Korea’. She is well-recognized for her powerful voice and extensive vocal range of G3-E5. Born in Denver, Colorado, Ailee grew up enjoying popular Korean music, often singing songs by S.E.S, Fin.K.L, Lee Hyo-ri & 2NE1, even watching Inkigayo and Music Bank episodes. She has studied ballet, jazz, and hip-hop dance as well as piano, drums, djembe, and flute. During her school years, Ailee won awards in the New Jersey Choir Contest. In 2006 she formed a band and performed on college events and underground events, even posting videos on YouTube. She also appeared in The Maury Show in 2008 and sang Rihanna's 'Unfaithful’, placing second. On September 13, 2011, she appeared as a trainee on the MBC Chuseok special pilot program ‘Singer and Trainee’ and won. Ailee made her debut on February 9, 2012 with the single "Heaven”. The song peaked at number three on the Gaon Digital Charts, and swept all the rookie awards at the year-end award shows. On October 16, 2012, Ailee released her debut EP Invitation, with the title track "I Will Show You”, for which she earned her first win on Music Bank. Ailee is a recipient of numerous awards including the Mnet America Rising Star Award, a special award presented by Mnet America at the pre-show of 55th Grammy Awards, which she attended. Her 2017 single, "I Will Go to You Like the First Snow” which was recorded for the soundtrack of the hit series Guardian: The Lonely and Great God (2016) was the most digitally successful song of that year, becoming the best-selling soundtrack in South Korea. The same year, she made her American debut with the single "Fall Back" under the stage name A.Leean. Ailee confirmed her relationship with actor-turned-entrepreneur Choi Si-hun in 2024. The couple married in a star-studded ceremony on April 20, 2025.
Ain, also known as Yejin, is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group SUS4 and the kids girl group Orange. She was also briefly a member of the cancelled girl group N-Bulance.
Ain is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group TWEETY. She left the group in 2019.
Ain is a South Korean singer under GOLDDUST Entertainment. She's a member of the girl group BEWAVE.
Aini is a South Korean influencer and retired singer. She is a former member of the girl group Scandal.

Aini is a South Korean singer under MyDoll Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl groups PinkFantasy, UNIZ and Kirots. On April 12, 2020, MyDoll released a statement saying Aini had departed from the group due to health concerns and in the future will be continue with personal activities under the agency.
Airi is a South Korean singer. She is best known for being in and founding the girl group MERAMERAHEART. She debuted on October 10, 2020, and graduated from the group on December 23, 2020.

Airi Kana is a South Korean V-Tuber and singer. She is a former member of the VTuber groups StelLive and YumePercent. Originally debuting as a soloist in May, 2023, with the single "ADDICT!ON", she later debuted in StelLive on February 21, 2024, as part of the subunit, 1st Generation 'Mystic'. Her birth year is unknown, but the date is known to be December 2.

Aisha is a South Korean rapper, dancer, and singer. She is a member of the girl group EVERGLOW. She made her debut with EVERGLOW on March 18, 2019 with the release of their first digital single "Arrival of Everglow", and its title song "Bon Bon Chocolat".
ajeomi is a soloist who debuted on March 15th, 2024 with the single “First”

Ajeong is a retired South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Playa and the duo Baby Sister. Ajeong made her solo debut on August 30, 2012, with the digital single "Looking For Your Love."

Akali is the main rapper of the virtual girl group K/DA. She always keeps her team on their toes and values her creative independence above all. She never settles for less and always works on new projects for her art.
Akane, formerly known as Leo is a South Korean singer-songwriter under 29production. She is a member of the underground idol girl group Kizuna Simulation and is a former member of Perfume de Ange.
Akane is a Japanese trainee and model under ON1 Entertainment. She is a former member of the pre-debut girl group Sweet Villain.

Akane Lize is a South Korean V-Tuber and singer under Accelers. She is a member of the South Korean VTuber group StelLive and part of the subunit: 2nd Generation 'Universe'. She debuted as a soloist on September 29, 2024 with the digital single ''Festa!''. Her birth year is unknown, but the date is known to be October 1.

Akari is a member of the upcoming Japanese girl group UN1CON (유니콘), which is based in Korea and produced by Roydo. The group lineup includes Manami, Joa, Kokoro, Akari, and Narae. UN1CON is set to make their debut in October 2024.
Akari is a Japanese singer. She was a contestant on Nizi Project.

Zhao Yue is a Chinese idol singer. She is a graduated member of Chinese idol group, SNH48 (Team NII), and an active member of its sub-unit SEN7ES (also known as 7Senses). She was also a member of Chinese project girl group Bonbon Girls 303, formed through the Chinese survival show Produce Camp 2020, where she placed 2nd.

Alex is an American singer formely under DR Music. She was the former leader of the girl group RaNia. Her addition to the group was announced on November 4, 2015 after being featured on RaNia's song 'Demonstrate'. She would go on to become the leader of the group on August 15, 2016. On August 19, 2017 DR Music announced her departure from the group, marking the end to her career as an idol.
Alexa, also known as Lex is an American (USA) singer, dancer and Youtuber, she is a member of American (USA) based Korean co-ed groups First Bite and Lalary.

AleXa also known as Kim Seri is an American singer formerly under ZB Label. She made her solo debut on October 21, 2019 with the single "Bomb". In 2016, she participated in audition competition program Rising Legends, presented by Soompi and JYP Entertainment. She won under the dancers category and received a one-on-one audition with JYPE. In 2017, she participated in Rising Legends: Season 2, eventually becoming the event's grand prize winner which included a five-day trip to Seoul and a chance to audition for Cube Entertainment. A Viki original series titled Legendary: Making of a K-Pop Star which follows her journey to South Korea for the K-pop experience premiered on January 11, 2018. In May 2018, she participated in Produce 48, representing ZB Label (a subsidiary under Zanybros). She was eliminated in episode 5 and finished in 82nd place. On October 1, 2019, Alex (now going under the name AleXa) released a teaser video on her Instagram for her then upcoming solo debut. She officially made her solo debut on October 21, 2019 with the digital single album "Bomb". On May 9, 2022, representing her home state of Oklahoma, AleXa came 1st on the American competition show "American Song Contest", making her the first person ever to be crowned the winner of the competition with her single "Wonderland". On March 5th she announced that she has left ZB Label and will be using her Korean name Kim Seri from now on.
ALi is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Soul Sting who made her official solo debut in 2009 with the album After The Love Has Gone.
Alice is a Japanese trainee under NiD Academy. She is best known for being a contestant on Under 15.
Alice is a South Korean trainee. She was a pre-debut member of the girl group tracer but she left the team before 2024.
Haelim is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group CST. She graduated art school in Korea and now she is an artist in Korea.

Alice is a Japanese singer under Na Entertainment and is a member of the upcoming global girl group NWH:I and the co-ed group DNA. Alice was the second member revealed, on January 10,2025. She is a former member of the pre-debut girl group DE:VA.
ALICE is a South Korean singer and songwriter who debuted in 2017 with the single album "Hope, Spring".

Alice Vicious, formally known as Livii is a South Korean recording artist, singer/songwriter, director, and CEO/model of fashion brand HAARP. Debuted on January 28, 2014. Since his debut, he has been constantly kitsch and has been constantly pushing the concept of Y2K atmosphere.

Alina is a Chinese trainee. She is a former pre-debut member of the girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE China. She is best known for being a contestant on the Chinese reality survival show Produce Camp 2020.
Alisa is a Chinese-Canadian trainee under BY-U Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group ARISE.
Alisha is an independent R&B singer. She made her debut in 2017 with the single “Love Me (Feat. Mutang & The $Eoul Kid)”.
Allie is a Chinese singer under World K-Pop Center. She is a member of the girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE China.
Ally is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Lady Collection. In 2007, she debuted solo under the stage name Ayn.
Alpha is a South Korean singer. She used to be a member of the group QODES.

Alyssa is a Malaysian-born trainee and former contestant on SBS survival show Universe Ticket. She was 18 years old when she participated in the survival show, which aimed to form a new girl group under F&F Entertainment. She is a multilingual who is fluent in Malay and English and conversational in Korean and Thai. Alyssa is known for her graceful yet powerful stage presence, earning her the nickname "Charisma Monster" among fans. During her time on Universe Ticket, she showcased her dance skills, including a performance of BLACKPINK's "DDU-DU DDU-DU," and was ranked 12th in the pro-voting standings before voluntarily exiting the show in Episode 4 due to personal reasons.
AMA is a South Korean live idol. She is a member of the group NEO-ASFiK.

Amber, also known as Amber Liu, is a Taiwanese-American rapper and singer currently active in South Korea, China and USA. At 15, she moved from her hometown of Los Angeles to Seoul to pursue her music career. A few years later, she debuted in 2009 in what would become the iconic K-pop group f(x). The group would go on to win numerous awards, becoming not only South Korea's biggest act but renowned internationally, with 6 of their albums reaching #1 on the charts. Since then, Amber has collaborated with top producers and acts including Anna Kendrick, Superfruit and R3hab. While working with SM Entertainment, Amber also signed a contract with Steel Wool Entertainment. Having over 5 million Instagram and 2 million Twitter followers, Amber has become an online influencer and icon to this generation. Amber debuted as a soloist on February 13, 2015 with the EP “Beautiful”. It debuted at number 2 on Billboard’s World Albums chart. Her title track, “Shake That Brass”, featured Girls’ Generation’s Taeyeon. She continues to evolve as an artist, songwriter, and creative director. In 2020, she made a splash with her self-produced mixtape “Rogue Rouge” and EP "X". In 2021, she released her third EP under Steel Wool Entertainment called "y?". "neon", the first single, features Peniel of BTOB. In 2019, Amber officially left SM Entertainment and started working with Steel Wool Entertainment only.

Americano is a South Korean singer and member of the girl group BB Ahn. Hse released a collaboration song called "Sad Melody" with the duo BGM. She also released four duo songs called “Why Do I Like My Lover?” with Strawberry Tart, “On a White Snowy Day” with Cotton Candy, “Reflection” with Tiramisu, and “I’m Not” with Taehwa. On January 24, 2012, she officially made her solo debut as Americano with the single album “Just Looking at it Feels Nice”. After BBAHN disbanded, she continued her career as a soloist under the group’s name. Her following album is titled “I Love You. I Like You. It’s Fate.”
Amet is a South Korean singer. She was a sub-vocalist of the girl group GP Basic.
Ami is a South Korean singer under Zenith Media Contents. She is a former member of the girl groups WANNA.B and NEP.
Ami is a Japanese trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.
Amin is a South Korean singer who debuted on January 10, 2018, with a digital single ‘Hide And Seek’.
Among is a Chinese rapper based in South Korea. She debuted on May 28, 2021 with LOVE WAVE, a collaborative single with Ann One and Juvie Train for the ON A!R PROJECT Part 2.
Amu is a South Korean singer-songwriter. She is a member of the underground idol girl group IHOTEU, the live idol cover unit-group MPK46 and a former member of Denpamaru!.

Amy Park (or simply Amy) is a South Korean dancer and choreographer under 71 Agency. She is a member of the project girl group TDYA, the dance group Colourfull Korea and the dance studio 1 MILLION. She is also known for being a contestant in Street Woman Fighter 2.

An Da Eun, or An Daeun, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and co-founder of the agency ADE Music. She is the vocalist of the duo, The ADE, that formed in July 2016. Before this, she was the vocalist of the duo Acoustic Collabo from August 2011 to June 2016. She also debuted as a soloist on November 20, 2020, with the digital single "I Was Young and I Wanted to Say I Was Sorry”. She also competed on JTBC’s 2021/2022 survival show “Sing Again 2” as Singer No. 48 and made it to the top 26.

Ahn Jin Kyung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group To-Ya. She was under WM Entertainment but left in 2012. Jin Kyoung retired from a career in music and entertainment in 2016. She later became employed as a store manager and eventually with her family opened a branch of Ediya Coffee on the Saemangeum Seawall.
An Shinae, also known as Ahn Shin Ae and Shinae An Wheeler, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under P NATION. She is a former member of The Barberettes.

An Solhee is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer. She debuted as a solo artist under the stage name Blue Berry on December 16, 2011 with digital single "Lovely Love". She later went onto joining numerous girl groups, including Scarlet, Pocket Girls, Cupid and lastly Icia. In mid-2020, she returned to working as a solo artist using her real name, An Solhee, as her stage name for the single "Rain Drop", which was released on July 9, 2020.
An Soyeon is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group A-plus. She is best known for participating in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Ana is a Japanese singer. She was a contestant on Nizi Project. She debuted as a soloist with the single “Bandaid” on September 30, 2023, under +1 MANAGEMENT with the stage name +1.

Anda, formerly known as Andamiro, is a South Korean singer under The Eye Entertainment. In 2012, Anda finally debuted as Andamiro under Trophy Entertainment with the dance single "Don't Ask" featuring Yang Dong-geun, gaining attention with the unique style of music, it has also earned her the nickname, "Korea's Lady Gaga". Following a two-year hiatus, she signed with Emperor Entertainment Korea and changed her stage name to simply as Anda. In August 2017, Anda signed an exclusive contract with Esteem Entertainment before eventually signing to the YG Entertainment subsidiary, YGX, in July 2018. In 2022, Anda officially joined Sublime Artist Agency.
Andamiro is a South Korean dancer, singer, rapper, and lyricist under HOMe. She is the maknae of the girl group Geenius.

Angelina Danilova is a Russian singer, model, actress, and popular television personality under The Prizm Entertainment originally under Palette Media. She made her solo singing debut with the digital single "As You Are" on January 17, 2020. In 2015, Angelina became an overnight sensation in Korean media when a Korean user reposted a 2014 image of her eating Korean food. The post quickly became viral across media platforms due to her beauty. In the spring of 2016, the agency Palette Media scouted Angelina and invited her to Korea for the filming and production of the reality survival show, 'Babel 250'. Since her appearance on the show, Angelina has met with huge success in Korean media and has appeared in over 10 television shows in the span of 3 years. Even starred in 'New Old Story' where she was Cinderella. In 2018, Angelina left Palette Media and joined The Prizm Entertainment. She was the 2018 recipient of the Korea Image Flower Stone Award for her work on promoting Korea to the world. She made her debut with the ballad digital single "As You Are" on January 17, 2020.
